SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTER.
File No.
No. D 5504
SECTION 12 30 / 11 / 33
Date November 25, 1933

Subject (in full) J. Nossoff, applicant for guard licence.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded [签名]

With reference to attached memo of the Personal
Assistant ( Crime Branch ) dated November 13, 1933, on the subject
of J. Nossoff, applicant for a guard licence, this individu-
al's history and record as known to this office are as follows:-

Joseph Matveievitch Nossoff, Russian, born 30-3-1899
at Briansk, Russia. He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on July 24,
1933. When registering with the Russian Emigrants Committee,
No 6-A Hongkong Road, he stated he left Russia in 1919 and
since that time resided for various periods in Harbin, Peiping and
Tientsin.

On November 2, 1933 he was engaged as a bodyguard at
the pay of $ 70.00 per month by Chang Wei Kwen of 366 Route
Tenant de la Tour, to whom he was recommended by the French Po-
lice.

〔此处转录不清〕

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

Special Branch.

〔批：To note 20/11/33.〕
〔签名〕

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记簿。
档案编号
D 5504 号
第 12 科 1933 年 11 月 30 日
日期：1933 年 11 月 25 日

事由（全称）：J. Nossoff，警卫执照申请人。

由特别股督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报。转呈 [签名]

关于随附的刑事科个人助理于 1933 年 11 月 13 日就 J. Nossoff（警卫执照申请人）一事所发的备忘录，本处所知的该人履历及记录如下：-

约瑟夫·马特维耶维奇·诺索夫（Joseph Matveievitch Nossoff），俄国人，1899 年 3 月 30 日出生于俄国布良斯克（Briansk）。他于 1933 年 7 月 24 日从哈尔滨抵达上海。在向香港路 6-A 号的俄国侨民委员会登记时，他称其于 1919 年离开俄国，此后分别在哈尔滨、北平和天津居住过不同时期。

1933 年 11 月 2 日，他受雇于谭德路（Route Tenant de la Tour）366 号的张伟坤（Chang Wei Kwen），担任保镖，月薪 70.00 元。此职位系由法国警察推荐。

〔此处转录不清〕

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别股督察

特别股。

〔批注：1933 年 11 月 20 日阅知。〕
〔签名〕
